critical_code_review_comments: server.py set_disabled_areas (L1175-1228) correctly handles delta between current & new disabled sets: newly_disabled zeroes+locks the cell (overrides[key]=[], unassigned_keys.add(key)), newly_enabled restores required from persons_required and REMOVES the key from unassigned_keys/overrides (unlocks for auto-fill). totals recomputed. Note: re-enabled cells do NOT auto-refill assigned_person_ids — freed associates remain in unassigned pool for manager to place via adjust flow, matching the specification.
